blueprints.subject: maths
blueprints.title: Place value to 999
blueprints.objective: Reads, writes, compares and decomposes whole numbers up to 999.
blueprints.teach: A digit’s value depends on its place. Hundreds, tens and ones can be composed, decomposed and compared.
blueprints.workedExample: In 472, what value does the digit 7 represent? The 7 is in the tens place, so its value is 70.

guidedTry.prompt: In 472, what value does the digit 7 represent?
guidedTry.hintLevel1: Name the hundreds, tens and ones places.
guidedTry.hintLevel2: The 7 is in the tens place, so its value is 70.

masteryTransfer.prompt: A shelf has 625 books and another has 652. Which shelf count is larger?

blueprints.reviewPrompt: Later, try a fresh place value to 999 task and explain the clue, rule or evidence you used.
blueprints.narrationText: A digit’s value depends on its place. Hundreds, tens and ones can be composed, decomposed and compared.
